what_happened.line: The Finance Committee closed the public hearing on the FY16 budget and tabled its budget vote to next week.
The town manager's revenue and expense adjustments left a surplus; members and residents debated using it for schools, police, snow and ice, and capital.
Only the 40R education aid matched to one-time school costs is included in the budget, and the state may not fund it.
The committee recommended the consent articles, prior year bills, and the solid waste and water enterprise funds.
It also recommended the Pleasant View Ave sewer extension, a police special detail fund and a sewer reserve capacity stabilization fund; a special meeting was proposed for April 2.

why_it_matters: How the surplus is divided among schools, police, snow and ice, and capital will shape the FY16 tax levy and the services residents see, and the budget vote has not yet been taken.
The sewer reserve fund holds capacity fees for future purchases from Fitchburg or Leominster, which touches sewer rates and capacity for future development.
